display.title: Episode 385: Torah, the Best Thing of All, Chapter 2 (Yud-Beis Tammuz)
display.summary_short: Summer vacation as a chance to see Hashem's world, a family recites the Shema, pirates prove Rabbi Akiva right, a Havdalah phone quiz, and the miracle of Yud-Beis Tammuz.
display.summary_long: Broadcast just before summer vacation and Yud-Beis Tammuz 5749. Uncle Yossi explains that vacation is a time to get to know Hashem by seeing the wonders of nature, and that Torah, davening and tzedakah every day bring a safe summer; he also offers a phone line listing Torah-true camps. After the Hakochainik march and a recap of last week's chapter, a visiting family of four children recites the Shema and the boys thank their yeshiva. Story time concludes 'Torah, the Best Thing of All': pirates attack the ship and seize all the merchants' riches, but Rabbi Akiva is calm, explaining that his Torah cannot be stolen and offering to teach even the pirate leader. The humbled merchants apologize and ask him to be their teacher. Mitzvah time reviews why we smell besamim at Havdalah, followed by a phone quiz in which a listener wins a braided Havdalah candle. The show closes with the story of Yud-Beis Tammuz, when the Frierdiker Rebbe was freed from Soviet prison after being sentenced for teaching Torah to children.
display.lesson: Torah is the one treasure no one can take away; use summer days and every day to grow closer to Hashem.
